title: Spectrum TG56PD Self-Propelled Petrol Lawnmower – 56cm, 196cc
description_html:
Big lawns deserve a mower that keeps pace. The Spectrum TG56PD pairs a wide 56cm cutting deck with self-propelled drive, so you cover more ground in fewer passes and let the mower do the pushing. It's built for homeowners with medium to large gardens who want a dependable, powerful cut without wrestling the machine up every slope.

Petrol power that doesn't quit

A robust 196cc four-stroke petrol engine drives through long, thick and damp grass without bogging down. With no cable to manage and no battery to recharge, you're free to roam the whole garden and keep mowing for as long as the job takes — ideal for lawns up to 1,800m².

Self-propelled drive takes the effort out

The powered drive pulls the TG56PD forward at a steady walking pace, so you guide rather than shove. On larger plots and gentle inclines, that's the difference between a chore and a comfortable morning's work.

The finish you want, every time

Eight cutting heights, set from a single lever, let you dial in anything from a tight, tidy cut to a longer length that protects the lawn through dry spells. One lever, both sides — no fiddling with each wheel.

Collect or mulch — your choice

Fit the generous 60-litre textile grass box for a clean, collected finish, with fewer trips to empty thanks to its size and a built-in grass-box-full indicator. Prefer to feed the lawn? Switch to mulching and the clippings are cut fine and returned to the turf, breaking down to release nutrients back into the soil.

Built to last, easy to store

A steel cutting deck stands up to season-after-season use, while foldable, adjustable soft-grip handles make the mower comfortable to steer and compact to store away. Backed by Spectrum's 5-year warranty (T&Cs apply), it's a mower built for the long haul.
